title: Change Risk Reviewer
subtitle: Before a change goes in, this agent works out how risky it is from what it touches, maps everything that depends on it and asks for the matching level of checking.
lede: Before a change goes in, this agent works out how risky it is from what it touches, maps everything that depends on it and asks for the matching level of checking.
who: An engineering manager who wants risky changes looked at harder
author: Corey James
